name: library-surface-non-graph-artifacts
body: `Cargo.toml`, `.cargo/config.toml`, `scripts/gate.sh`, and `rust-toolchain.toml` each carry a `File` node (`code_type = 'config'`) from the shipped structural scanner, so each is an `implemented-by` or task target addressable by FQN. Adding `src/lib.rs` alongside `src/main.rs` makes two source files want the module identity `rust.apg`; the crate-root module belongs to `src/main.rs`, so the plan decides how the library target is rooted (and whether the binary re-exports or renames) with the FQN collision-free. The spec records that plan-writer decision.
